prompts.baseforce: Use case: historical-scene. Asset type: small illustrated unit card for a 1933-1950 Japanese alternate-history grand strategy mod. Create an original wide 3:2 composition in restrained colourized archival-photo style, high readable contrast. Japanese naval base defence troops in practical dark olive work uniforms and cloth caps preparing a modest coastal antiaircraft position beside a repair jetty on a tropical island, 1939 equipment, crates, signal wire and a few merchant hulls behind. Main subject tightly clustered centrally so it reads at 192x104 and 67x44 pixels. Grounded military scene, no heroic leader portrait, no text, no badges or insignia closeups, no rising-sun propaganda banner, no modern weapons. Warm muted khaki and blue sea, distinct from infantry marching artwork.
prompts.jungleforce: Use case: historical-scene. Asset type: small illustrated unit card for a Japanese alternate-history grand strategy mod. Original wide 3:2 composition in restrained colourized archival-photo style with high readable contrast. Tightly clustered central figures readable at 192x104 and 67x44 pixels. Muted leaf greens and wet earth, natural overcast light.
